subject: Close-to-live orchestration: phased launch MAP, canary pilots & trainer lanes
messages:
From: Ellie Patterson <ellie@cascadeworks.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Close-to-live MAP: draft timeline + pilots

Jordan / team —

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the commercial side. Attached is our draft mutual action plan (cascade_MAP_v1.xlsx) — I pulled together the milestone-level dates we discussed on Friday and added notes about the canary scope and training expectations. High-level asks:

- Confirm canary success criteria (traffic %, error thresholds, user acceptance gates).
- Confirm whether we should run the first canary on Redwood Hosted or provision a small Dedicated pool for the pilot.
- Confirm training cadence: train-the-trainer + two end-user waves (internal ops, then support).
- Deliver an evaluation plan (prompt set + pass/fail rules) to validate generation quality at T-0 and after the migration.

Key dates from our side (in the spreadsheet):
- Week 0 (2028-05-20): SSO + network whitelists complete.
- Week 1–2 (2028-05-27 to 2028-06-09): Staged canary (3 waves: 1% / 10% / 25%).
- Week 3 (2028-06-10): Migration window for full cutover if canary passes.
- Week 4–6 (2028-06-17 to 2028-07-01): Training waves + hypercare.

Procurement will want a DocuSign envelope and a PO once we lock dates — cc'd procurement@cascadeworks.com. Can you confirm resource owners (implementation lead, SRE on-call, evaluation owner) so I can add them to the MAP?

Thanks,
Ellie Patterson
Head of Platform — CascadeWorks
ellie@cascadeworks.com

Attachments: cascade_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft, milestones sheet)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Patterson <ellie@cascadeworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close-to-live MAP: draft timeline + pilots

Ellie —

Appreciate the MAP and the clear milestones. Quick answers and a few clarifying items below.

1) Canary success criteria
- Latency: p95 under 300ms for gen calls at the target load.
- Error rate: <0.5% 5xx for both inference and routing failures.
- Quality: automated eval pass-rate >= 92% on the supplied prompt set (we received a placeholder in the MAP).
- Operational: no >2 incidents that require rollback during a single wave.

I'll attach a short doc (canary_criteria.md) with the metric definitions and observable queries for Redwood Console. Can you confirm the acceptance owner on your side for the quality gate?

2) Hosted vs Dedicated for pilot
- Recommendation: run wave 1 (1%) on Hosted to validate integration, wave 2 (10%) on Dedicated reserved pool to confirm throughput/latency at scale, then wave 3 (25%) on Dedicated with warm KV cache and pre-warmed model instances.
- If you prefer all on Hosted, we can do that, but we may see higher latency variability during peak traffic.

3) Training cadence
- Proposed: 1-day train-the-trainer session the week prior to wave 2 (target 2028-06-03), then two 90-minute end-user webinars (2028-06-12 and 2028-06-19).

4) Evaluation plan
- We will supply an initial eval_prompt_set.jsonl containing 250 prompts and gold labels for automated QA, plus a monitoring dashboard that flags regressions. We will also run a blind A/B on wave 2 traffic for quality comparison.

Resource owners (proposed):
- Implementation lead: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com)
- SRE on-call / runtime ops: Jordan Blake (me) and team rotation
- Evaluation owner: Mina Haddad (mina_haddad@redwood.com)

If that all aligns I can update the MAP and add the Redwood runbook references (canary criteria doc + eval prompt set). I can also initiate the DocuSign envelope once we lock the final dates.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachment: canary_criteria.md (metric defs + console queries)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close-to-live MAP: draft timeline + pilots

Jordan / Mina —

Confirmed on our side: I will be the implementation lead for CascadeWorks (point for runbook updates, cutover calls, and acceptance gates). Mina, please own the eval plan and the post-cutover quality monitoring.

Couple of ops notes to add to the MAP before we send the next draft to Ellie:
- Warmup: include a KV cache warmup step 24h before wave 3. We'll schedule synthetic traffic to build cache for common prefixes.
- Quantization profile: lock on the selected quant profile for the Dedicated pool prior to wave 2; this avoids quiet regressions from a mid-pilot re-quantize.
- Rollback cadence: if a wave crosses any critical threshold (latency p95 >500ms OR quality drop >6pp) we will trigger immediate rollback to the previous model variant and re-run wave with mitigation changes.
- Support: I will schedule a 4-hour hypercare window after cutover with on-call SRE, CS, and a product SME.

Mina — can you confirm the eval prompt set scope? I recommend 250 prompts covering top-10 intents + 30 adversarial cases (hallucination/overcommit patterns). Also include a small human review sample (20 items) for subjective judgments.

Once Mina confirms I will update cascade_MAP_v1.xlsx and send to Ellie with the requested DocuSign link placeholder.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: eval_prompt_set.jsonl (placeholder to be filled by Mina)

From: Ellie Patterson <ellie@cascadeworks.com>

Subject: Re: Close-to-live MAP: draft timeline + pilots

Team —

This looks great, and the timeline maps to our internal launch plan. Procurement will issue PO_Cascade_001.pdf once DocuSign is received. A few quick confirmations:

- Acceptance owner for the quality gate: Lina Gomez (lina.gomez@cascadeworks.com).
- We approve the Hosted -> Dedicated phased approach you proposed.
- Train-the-trainer on 2028-06-03 is confirmed (2 people from our side: Lina + Samir Patel).

Next steps for Redwood please:
1) Update the MAP with the canary criteria language and the warmup/rollback bullets.
2) Attach the eval_prompt_set.jsonl (or a link) so our QA team can preview.
3) Send DocuSign envelope for signature and cc procurement@cascadeworks.com.

I'll mark the MAP as green from our side pending the updated attachment and the DocuSign link. Excited to run the pilot.

Best,
Ellie Patterson

ellie@cascadeworks.com
